articles.title: Building OneLifeVibe: Designing a Hub So Occasional Tools Stay Findable — What Worked, What Broke
articles.excerpt: Every product has two kinds of users: the ones who show up daily, and the ones who show up a few times a year with a specific job in mind. The second group is easy to lose, and not because the product…
articles.body: Every product has two kinds of users: the ones who show up daily, and the ones who show up a few times a year with a specific job in mind. The second group is easy to lose, and not because the product failed them. They come back months later, cannot quite remember the name, start from a search engine instead, and may or may not arrive. Building OneLifeVibe — a hub of focused, single-purpose sites behind one front door — turned into a design problem about that second group. The question was not how to make people visit more often. It was how to make a site worth returning to findable again at the exact moment its job comes back around. What worked One front door instead of many half-remembered names.

articles.title: Polymarket Trading Bot: Building a Real-Time Polymarket Market Maker( How WebSockets and Low-Latency Architecture Work)
articles.excerpt: Why real-time market data, local order books, and asynchronous execution matter when building an automated Polymarket trading system. A trading strategy is only as good as the information behind it. I…
articles.body: Why real-time market data, local order books, and asynchronous execution matter when building an automated Polymarket trading system. A trading strategy is only as good as the information behind it. Imagine you're running an automated trading bot on Polymarket, monitoring BTC 5-minute Up or Down markets. Your bot identifies an opportunity. The current best bid is $0.49, and the best ask is $0.51. Based on its strategy, it calculates a new bid and ask and prepares to place orders. But there's a problem. While your bot is calculating its next move, another trader submits a large order. The order book changes, liquidity shifts, and the market moves. Your bot is now making a decision using information that may already be outdated.

articles.title: One forward pass per level: replaying Next-Concept Modeling in the browser
articles.excerpt: Halfway through its 12 sweeps, a Next-Concept Model story is word salad with the characters already in place. I built a browser player that replays real generations level by level so you can watch tha…
articles.body: Halfway through its 12 sweeps, a Next-Concept Model story is word salad with the characters already in place. I built a browser player that replays real generations level by level so you can watch that sharpening happen. What NCM is. Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), from HazyResearch at Stanford, generates text coarse to fine (paper: arXiv 2610.14162). A multiscale residual VQ tokenizer represents a story as 12 nested sets of discrete codes, growing from 1 concept code to 128. A transformer predicts that whole hierarchy with one forward pass per level, not one token at a time. What I built. A static page in vanilla JavaScript: no server, no GPU in the browser.

articles.body: If NASA ever hopes to build a permanent moon base for astronauts, let alone aim for Mars, the U.S. space agency is going to need a whole lot of space travelers. And now, you have a chance to be one of them. NASA on Saturday (Nov. 7) put out the call for a new class of astronaut candidates who think they have the "right stuff" to fly, live and work in space. articles.body: SpaceX will make spaceflight history this week, if all goes according to plan. "If successful, this will mark the first full recovery of an orbital launch system and a breakthrough moment in making Starship a reliable, rapidly reusable rocket." articles.body: Thanks to a combination of radar, infrasound, dash-cam and security camera footage, astronomers have tracked the bright daytime meteor that fell over Cape Cod Bay in May 2026 back to its origin as a small asteroid perturbed by Jupiter and sent on a comet-like orbit towards Earth. Meteor fireballs visible in the daytime are referred to as 'bolides'. At 1:06 p.m. local time (18:06 UTC) on May 30, 2026 one such bolide was widely witnessed falling out of the sky over coastal Massachusetts, with members of the public also reporting an associated sonic boom that rumbled across the north-eastern coast of the United States.
articles.author: Keith Cooper

articles.title: NASA unveils $10 billion in moon base contracts, new lunar missions and the 'PROMISE' of a nuclear-powered rover
articles.excerpt: NASA is pushing ahead with its plan to build a moon base for astronauts by 2032, unveiling up to $10 billion in new contracts to launch and deliver cargo to Earth's nearest neighbor.
articles.body: CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA is pushing ahead with its plan to build a moon base for astronauts by 2032, with the agency unveiling up to $10 billion in contracts to launch and deliver cargo to the moon and other efforts on Saturday (Nov. 7). The NASA announcement, revealed here during the space agency's "Max Power" air show event at Kennedy Space Center , included plans for a new $10 billion Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) framework, dubbed CLPS 2, about$1.3 billion in funding for the agency's Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) program, and the nuclear-powered "PROMISE" rover on the moon.
articles.author: Josh Dinner

articles.title: NASA chief Jared Isaacman skydives into space agency's MAX POWER air show — 'Going into this job, I knew we had to do something like this.'
articles.excerpt: "I promise you, there'll be more to come."
articles.body: CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman knows how to make an entrance. Under the bright afternoon sun on Saturday (Nov. 7), Isaacman plummeted through the air above 10,000 onlookers, skydiving into the agency's air show MAX POWER. MAX POWER overtook NASA's Kennedy Space Center here over the weekend, combining aeronautics and aerospace in a massive public air show, the first of its kind for the space agency. A mix of astronauts, fighter jet displays and new technology on display, the spectacle is a lot space-ier than a traditional air show, and Isaacman made sure to really showcase this merging of worlds.
articles.author: Chelsea Gohd

articles.title: Innovating with AI in the special chemicals industry
articles.excerpt: As companies look to accelerate innovation with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and advanced modeling, the primary challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data, scientific exper…
articles.body: As companies look to accelerate innovation with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and advanced modeling, the primary challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data, scientific expertise, and the practical realities of bringing products to market. For specialty chemicals manufacturer Lubrizol, digital transformation is all about giving researchers the tools to test ideas faster, make better-informed decisions, and develop more sustainable materials without compromising performance. Girish Rao, vice president of information technology at Lubrizol, says the company is building a digital foundation that connects business processes, modern data platforms, and cloud infrastructure to support its research and development (R&D) teams.

articles.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
articles.excerpt: This week, as countries meet in Antalya, Turkey for the United Nations climate conference, one topic likely to dominate the conversation is artificial intelligence. The host has already called on coun…
articles.body: This week, as countries meet in Antalya, Turkey for the United Nations climate conference, one topic likely to dominate the conversation is artificial intelligence. The host has already called on countries to commit to ensuring that AI is designed, powered, and deployed in ways that support climate action. But so far, industries around the world aren’t doing nearly enough to harness the technology to actually drive down the greenhouse-gas emissions heating up the planet, despite some very optimistic claims from AI companies.
